Scenario fixture: label-in-name (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name)

Applicability requires the control to (a) match the selector (interactive control with a non-empty aria-label or aria-labelledby, not [hidden]/[disabled]/[aria-disabled="true"]), (b) be visually rendered (DOM-visible; note aria-hidden on the control itself does NOT gate this — see case 14), and (c) have a deterministically-extractable visible text label — text inside an aria-hidden descendant does not count as visible label text (an aria-hidden icon-font glyph, e.g. an icon ligature, is technically DOM-visible pixels but never perceived as literal readable words — see case 13). When applicable, the rule fails if the normalized accessible name does not contain the normalized visible label as a substring. Each target has a stable id lin_case_NN.

A. Baseline: accessible name contains visible label

01 — PASS: button aria-label is a superset of visible text
02 — FAIL: button aria-label unrelated to visible text
03 — PASS: case-insensitive + whitespace-normalized match
04 — FAIL: accessible name is a strict subset missing part of the visible label
05 — PASS: <a href> aria-labelledby text contains visible self content
Download Download the quarterly report

B. Native form controls: visible label from <label> association

06 — FAIL: input wrapped by <label>, aria-label mismatched
07 — PASS: input with <label for>, aria-label matches
08 — PASS: <select> with <label for> matching aria-labelledby
Country selector

C. Not applicable: no extractable visible label / not a match candidate

09 — N/A: no aria-label/aria-labelledby at all (excluded by selector)
10 — N/A: not visually rendered (display:none, excluded via DOM-visibility gate)
11 — N/A: disabled input (excluded by selector)
12 — N/A: aria-disabled="true" (excluded by selector)

D. aria-hidden on the control itself does NOT gate applicability; on a descendant, it DOES exclude that text from the visible-label comparison

13 — N/A: only content is an aria-hidden decorative glyph, which does not count as visible label text
14 — FAIL: control itself is aria-hidden="true" but still visually rendered with a visible label mismatch

E. Other interactive roles in the selector list

15 — FAIL: role=checkbox, aria-label mismatched with visible text
Gift wrap
16 — PASS: role=tab, aria-label superset of visible text
Overview
17 — PASS: aria-hidden decorative icon alongside real visible text — the icon is excluded, only "Save" is compared

End of fixture.
